author: JethroFortune
body:
Hello my username is jethrofortune99.
I was playing nebula my favorite game on the avicus network when i suddenly was kicked from the server.
It said i was punished by mod excellence for scamming?! I dint do anything wrong all i did was play nebula like you were supposed to; kill others and destroy the monument. I beg that i am un-banned i have played on this server since it was called mczone and i have loved it.

replies.author: Two_Become_One
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to Deny your appeal.

This is a valid punishment. You were attempting to scam others into leaving the match so you could join. This is a punishable offence. I suggest you read the rules.

Regards,
ItzDylan115, Senior Mod
